explication_en: HTTPTypes defines HTTPRequest and HTTPResponse around HTTPFields, made up of HTTPField whose name is typed by HTTPFieldName. HTTPTypesFoundation converts these types to URLRequest and URLResponse and adds URLSession methods, with dedicated tests and benchmarks.
